name: Navafría (Spain)
description: Vertically divided yellow and white with the yellow hoist third charged with a green eradicated pine, the white fly with a blue wavy bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: Navafría adopted its arms and flag officially on 4 March 2005, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 20 June 2005; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two vertical stripes in the proportions 1/3 and 2/3, the hoist yellow with a green eradicated pine.

features.role: wavy bend on the white from the upper hoist to the lower fly
